\[
I_{\text{out}}(x,y) = \frac{\displaystyle\sum_{(s,t) \in S_{xy}} I(s,t)^{Q+1}}{\displaystyle\sum_{(s,t) \in S_{xy}} I(s,t)^{Q}},
\qquad Q = 1.5
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(S_{xy}\): The window around pixel (x, y)
- \(Q\): The order of the filter

Each value is weighted by its own power Q. With Q above 0 the bright values weigh more, so black specks hardly count. With Q below 0 the dark values weigh more, so white specks hardly count. When Q is below 0 and the window holds a 0, the output is 0, the limit of the formula.
